messages.author: e6aee7c34ba7001a
messages.subject: Error running example code bnames-cluster.r
parts:
Hi,

I encountered "Error in class ..." shown below while running the code
in bnames-cluster.r from plyr/plyr-tutorial/examples.

The error is generated by the line
"percent_smo = scale01(smooth(percent, year))"

Regards,

Gerry.

> # Hmmmm. Maybe be clustering too much based on absolute size, and not
> # on relative shape. Lets rescale percent to 0,1
>
> library(mgcv)
This is mgcv 1.7-2. For overview type 'help("mgcv-package")'.
> smooth <- function(var, date) {
+ predict(gam(var ~ s(date)))
+ }
> scale01 <- function(x) (x - min(x)) / diff(range(x))
>
> bnames_long <- ddply(bnames_long, c("sex", "name"), transform,
+ percent_std = scale01(percent),
+ percent_smo = scale01(smooth(percent, year))
+ )
Error in class(output[[var]]) <- class(value) :
cannot set class to "array" unless the dimension attribute has
length > 0
>

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Error running example code bnames-cluster.r
parts:
Hi Margaret,

Use this version of smooth and you should be ok:

smooth <- function(var, date) {
as.vector(predict(gam(var ~ s(date))))
}

Hadley
